Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
I have a question on the interaction of WWEF and 2nd Tradition.
Consider the following two cards:

Doofus, the Amazing Stealth Monkey (Ape)
Unique Malkavian Ally
2 pool
2 life, 0 hand damage, 2 bleed
Once per action, Doofus may play an action modifier requiring Obfuscate
as if he possessed the superior version of that Discipline. Any cost in
blood is paid for with his life; if a card would give him blood, give him
life. If Doofus is burned in combat, the Methuselah controlling the
opposing minion gains 2 pool.

Vulgar, the puppet Gangrel
5 capacity
ANI for
Prince of Minneapolis
Vulgar may not take actions that require a Prince.

Doofus bleeds. Vulgar is tapped, and plays WWEF to block. Doofus whips
out a Lost in Crowds for +2 stealth. Can Vulgar play the Second Tradition:
Domain? Or does WWEF render him 'untapped' for purposes of qualifying
for the 'tapped' requirement of Second Tradition?

The crux of the question seems to be: How 'untapped' is the faux-untapped
state granted by WWEF?

gomi

--
kono sora wo daite kagayaku,
shounen yo shinwa ni nare.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Gomi no Sensei wrote:
>
> I have a question on the interaction of WWEF and 2nd Tradition.

> [two cards that are not important to the question snipped]
>
> [Vamp1] bleeds. [Vamp2] is tapped, and plays WWEF to block. [Vamp1] whips
> out a Lost in Crowds for +2 stealth. Can [Vamp2] play the Second Tradition:

> Domain? Or does WWEF render him 'untapped' for purposes of qualifying
> for the 'tapped' requirement of Second Tradition?
>
> The crux of the question seems to be: How 'untapped' is the faux-untapped
> state granted by WWEF?

The awakened vampire (Vamp2) is not untapped in any sense - although
he *may* block and player reaction cards *as if* untapped.

He is free to play Domain, since he is tapped (as required by the
VTES version of Domain) and needs the intercept.
